title: Network pharmacology and molecular docking analysis predict the mechanisms of Huangbai liniment in treating oral lichen planus.
authors: Chang, Wei; Shi, Jing; Li, Lingzhi; Zhang, Ping; Ren, Yanrong; Yan, Yan; Ge, Yana
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究黄柏洗剂治疗口腔扁平苔藓的机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study explored the mechanism of Huangbai liniment (HB) for the treatment of oral lichen planus (OLP) through network pharmacology and molecular docking techniques. The study identified HB' active ingredients, therapeutic targets for OLP, and associated signaling pathways. The chemical composition of HB was screened using the HERB database. The disease targets of OLP were obtained through the GeneCards and OMIM databases. A protein-protein interactions network was constructed with the String platform. Topological analysis was performed using Cytoscape software to identify core targets. Gene ontology and Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes pathway enrichment analysis were performed using the Hiplot database, and the active ingredients and core targets were verified by molecular docking. Date analysis showed that the active composition of HB in the treatment of OLP were quercetin, wogonin, kaempferol, and luteolin. This survey identified 10 potential therapeutic targets, including TNF, CXCL8, IL-6, IL1B, PIK3R1, ESR1, JUN, AKT1, PIK3CA, and CTNNB1. Molecular docking revealed stable interactions between OLP' key targets and HB. These key targets were predominantly involved in the PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, AGE-RAGE signaling pathway, TNF signaling pathway, and HIF-1 signaling pathway. HB plays a crucial role in the treatment of OLP, acting on multiple targets and pathways, particularly the PI3K-Akt signaling pathway. It regulated biological processes like the proliferation of epithelial cells and lymphocytes and mediates the expression of transcription factors, cytokines, and chemokines. Therefore, this study provides a theoretical basis for the clinical trial and application of HB in the therapy of OLP.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过网络药理学和分子对接技术，探讨了黄柏洗剂（HB）治疗口腔扁平苔藓（OLP）的机制。研究确定了HB的活性成分、OLP的治疗靶点及相关信号通路。利用HERB数据库筛选HB的化学成分，通过GeneCards和OMIM数据库获取OLP的疾病靶点。使用String平台构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，并采用Cytoscape软件进行拓扑分析以识别核心靶点。通过Hiplot数据库进行基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书通路富集分析，并通过分子对接验证活性成分与核心靶点。数据分析显示，HB治疗OLP的活性成分为槲皮素、汉黄芩素、山柰酚和木犀草素。本研究识别出10个潜在治疗靶点，包括TNF、CXCL8、IL-6、IL1B、PIK3R1、ESR1、JUN、AKT1、PIK3CA和CTNNB1。分子对接揭示了OLP关键靶点与HB之间的稳定相互作用。这些关键靶点主要参与PI3K-Akt信号通路、AGE-RAGE信号通路、TNF信号通路和HIF-1信号通路。HB在OLP治疗中发挥关键作用，作用于多个靶点和通路，尤其是PI3K-Akt信号通路。它调节上皮细胞和淋巴细胞增殖等生物过程，并介导转录因子、细胞因子和趋化因子的表达。因此，本研究为HB在OLP治疗中的临床试验和应用提供了理论基础。
